text:
tom-release: Starting scheduled canary rollout for inference-gateway v1.14.0 to prod (eu-west-1) in ~10m. PR #842 pinned. Will monitor canary metrics and proceed if green.

lee-sre: heads up — we're seeing a Redis master restart in eu-west-1, caused connection flaps. 5xx spike and cache miss storm for services relying on prefix caching. Recommend we hold this rollout.

sam-eng: confirming high tail latency on inference-gateway from the last 5m, memcache/cache fills are thrashing. Agree hold.

maya-platform: +1 hold. Suggest we pin service to last known-good (v1.13.9) for any partial canaries that already rolled.

tom-release: How many canary hosts already updated?

sam-eng: 2/20 canary instances got v1.14.0 about 3m ago. Traffic routed 1%. Errors spiked on those hosts.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout paused by tom-release (reason: incident in eu-west-1). Canary batches halted.

lee-sre: Action plan: 1) Pause further rollouts (done). 2) Roll back the 2 canary hosts to v1.13.9 to avoid noisy signals. 3) Pin release tag so deploys don't auto-retry. 4) Reschedule full rollout to next maintenance window (24h).

maya-platform: For rollback: run `./deploy rollback --service inference-gateway --to v1.13.9 --scope canary --region eu-west-1` (will target the 2 updated hosts).

tom-release: executing rollback command now.

sam-eng: rollback in progress — logs: 
```
Rolling back host igw-canary-02 -> v1.13.9
Rolling back host igw-canary-07 -> v1.13.9
Health checks reattached, traffic gradually shifted
```

sam-eng: rollback completed, both hosts on v1.13.9. Error rate returning to baseline.

jenna-pm: Should we send a short note to customers? Impact looks internal but we saw some increased latencies. Drafting a brief status page update.

lee-sre: I'm opening an incident: INC-2026-045 — redis master restart -> cache stampede. Linking this thread. We'll keep the release paused until incident is resolved + one green hour of steady metrics.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-045 created by lee-sre: Redis restart caused cache invalidation surge in eu-west-1. Sev: S2.

maya-platform: Re: pinning — I'll create a branch pin and update deploy config to prevent auto-advance. We should also disable the automatic canary retry rule for 24h.

tom-release: Rescheduling the v1.14.0 window to tomorrow 12:00 UTC (24h). Will re-open thread if incident clears earlier.

sam-eng: I'll push a quick telemetry check to alert if latency climbs post-restart during recovery window.

jenna-pm: Status page draft posted in #incidents-drafts, tagging @ops to review.

maya-platform: Confirmed deploy config updated: release pin applied, auto-retry disabled.

tom-release: Thanks all. Pause + pin + rollback done. Reopen when INC-2026-045 is resolved and we have stable metrics for 1h. :white_check_mark:

lee-sre: +1. Leave the thread open for updates.

deploy-bot: Note: next scheduled retry removed from queue; manual deploy required when ready.

jenna-pm: Noted — adding a short note to the release notes about the delay once we resume.

sam-eng: quick thumbs-up test — metrics look normal for the last 10m. Keeping monitoring on. :thumbsup:
